Effective Large-Scale Reading Instruction The Province of Chaco implemented a provincial literacy reform, replacing global approaches First Grade with the structured literacy program Aprendo Leyendo. To evaluate its impact, an international team led by Lic. Florencia Salvarezza and composed of Haskins Laboratories, the Universidad de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires, Yale Child Study Center, University of Connecticut, CONICET, and Fundación INECO, conducted research with 1,319 1st and 2nd grade students from public schools. The study compared the 2025 cohort, which received the intervention, with the 2024 control cohort using the EGRA assessment. Main Results First Grade: The group that used the program significantly outperformed the control group across all reading skills evaluated, achieving the most notable improvement in reading comprehension. Second Grade: Students demonstrated significantly higher performance in letter-sound knowledge (a fundamental skill), as well as in word reading, pseudowords, sentence reading, and reading comprehension. Conclusions These findings support the effectiveness of the program in improving early reading skills during the first years of schooling. Furthermore, the results demonstrate that structured and explicit literacy instruction can be successfully implemented on a large scale. For Teachers, By Teachers Authentic Aprendo Leyendo was written by Latin American authors. All the stories are authentic and relevant to the culture and people of the continent. The teacher instructions are concise and easily accessible. There is no need for a large assortment of books and materials for each area of study. Everything children need for a lesson is contained in just two books: a decodable chapter book and a Skills Book. Effective Aprendo Leyendo is a beginning reading program that incorporates reading, spelling, and handwriting using multisensory techniques. It utilizes the best instructional practices supported by scientific research and is an effective program for all children. Comprehensive Aprendo Leyendo contains all the critical elements of a comprehensive reading program for primary grades: phonemic awareness, phonics, decoding, word recognition, vocabulary, spelling, handwriting, and comprehension strategies. All these vital components of reading are taught simultaneously in integrated lessons, each subject reinforcing and strengthening the others. What are teachers saying? “My 1st grade students started to read aloud at the beginning of the course and by the end of the year were able to read an entire book by themselves. Witnessing the progress of their literary skills is amazing, especially their motivation, their willingness to read aloud in each class with no fear of making mistakes, their enthusiasm for ongoing learning. As a teacher, it is exciting to be part of this. Listening to them read and watching them smile is a gift in every reading class!” Sofía, 1 st grade reading teacher 1

For Students Chapter Books These beautifully illustrated decodable chapter books are unlike any other beginning readers. The narratives have all the basic elements of good storytelling—character, setting, plot, conflict, and resolution. Children love the adventure and humor! The decodable text only contains sounds that have been taught so that children can sound out the words. There is a repetition of vocabulary to develop recognition of common words and the length of words and complexity of sentences gradually increases. The books provide the practice needed to develop accurate and fluent reading, as well as coherent stories that support effective comprehension strategies. Skills Books Each chapter book has a corresponding Skills Book. Comprehensive Skills Books contain activities for teachers to provide direct instruction in phonemic awareness, decoding, word recognition, spelling, vocabulary, comprehension and handwriting. They are meant to be used under teacher supervision with discussion and immediate feedback. 2

For Teachers Teacher Editions Each chapter book also has a Teacher Edition that provides prompts to support children’s engagement and understanding of the stories. The resulting class discussions encourage logical reasoning, making inferences, and a range of comprehension strategies, including rereading, paraphrasing, and summarizing. Aprendo Leyendo Teacher Handbook The Teacher Handbook includes detailed instructions on how to implement the program, as well as words and sentences for spelling dictations for each level of the AL sequence. Professional Development Professional Development, in the form of courses, workshops, and ongoing teacher support, is provided by experienced AL teachers and can be tailored to the needs of individual schools and districts.
